selection.adapter: Good Display DESPI-C02, current 2025-09-26 PCB photo / Rev 2.0 manual
selection.pairing_evidence: The GDEY0397T81P manufacturer product page explicitly pairs it with DESPI-C02.
selection.stock_header_retained: 8-pin 2.54 mm right-angle male header; no desoldering assumed

panel_verified_mm.fpc_direction: With the front-facing screen upright and FPC down, the tail dog-legs left. Contact tongue is near the left panel edge. It is not centered.

adapter_verified.fpc_contact_type: top or top/bottom contact, per manual
adapter_verified.fpc_exit: Outward through the short edge opposite the 8-pin wire header
adapter_verified.fpc_insertion: Display white face up with C02 component/connector face up when flat; close latch after insertion
adapter_verified.source: despi_c02_spec.pdf, Rev 2.0 2025-10-26, and official 2025 product photographs

adapter_provisional_packaging_allowances.not_included_in_pin_projection: Any female plug housing, wire solder joint, heat shrink, bend radius and strain relief
adapter_provisional_packaging_allowances.status: Conservative provisional allowances. No manufacturer complete Z-height drawing or dimensioned connector placement found. Physical sample verification required.

photo_scaled_estimates_mm.coordinate_system: Official front flat photo; origin is PCB upper-left before rotation, X along 41 mm toward FPC connector, Y along 22 mm short axis. These are photo-derived estimates, not dimensioned tolerances.
photo_scaled_estimates_mm.root_trial_placement: For PCB x45..67, y66..107, FPC down: FPC housing roughly x46.5..65.5, y100.5..106; wire pins roughly x45.8..66.2, y60..66; header plastic and bent solder tails extend onto PCB to y~70.2. This RIGHT-side placement does not align with a simple fold of the panel's BOTTOM/LEFT tongue.

fit_rules: Do not mirror the real panel's FPC dog-leg to make the mockup fit.
With a bottom FPC and a simple fold, align the C02 tongue/socket near panel-left plus 6.25 mm; rotate the physical display 180 degrees only if the opposite FPC location is intended.
A 180-degree flex fold changes the connector-board face orientation; count components on both sides of the C02.
FPC route, fold radius, wire terminations, gasket and service slack require explicit geometry. They are not included in the bare component dimensions.
The shipping protective film is excluded from the specified bare-panel thickness; do not omit any permanent optical layers.
